articles.title: Messi's Magic 8th Goal Puts Him on Top in World Cup Golden Boot Race!
articles.summary: Lionel Messi scored his 8th goal to lead the Golden Boot race. Kylian Mbappe and Erling Haaland are close behind with 7 each. The quarterfinals start Thursday.

articles.title: This Factory Let Workers Choose Their Hours—and It Was a Game Changer!
articles.summary: A Georgia appliance factory was short hundreds of workers. Then it let people pick their own shifts with an app. Now 450 flexible workers help build ovens and ranges.

articles.title: Judge Says No: Trump Can't Get Georgia Election Workers' Private Info
articles.summary: A judge blocked the Trump administration from getting names and contact info of Georgia election workers from 2020. Also, a NYC high-rise almost collapsed, and Farage quit Parliament.
